title: SuperTag Objective manifest
description: A declared Objective, applied with supertag apply -f or from the objectives map of supertag.yaml. metadata.name is the Objective ID. Like the project file, it rejects unknown fields so typos fail early. Status is observed, never declared.

spec.description: owner, outcome, ongoing, workspaces, and which Team the Objective names are fixed once it exists; apply refuses a change to them. deadline, budget increases, runtimeActions, and the Objective's own Team change in place.

outcome.description: One natural-language statement: the result, how success is verified, what must not change, and when to ask a person.

ongoing.description: A continuing responsibility that only an operator can end.

workspaces.description: Names of existing Workspaces the Objective's work may use.

budget.description: The allocation limit. With currency, it caps provider-reported cost; it can only increase after creation.

runtimeActions.description: Runtime actions, such as files:write, for turns that start afterwards. Omitted: what the owner's Permission Sets allow at creation. A list narrows that set.

team.description: The Team whose members the owner may hand work to: an existing Team's name, or the Objective's own Team, whose Team ID is the Objective ID. Which Team is fixed once the Objective exists; its own Team's name, members, and maxConcurrency change in place.
